name: 48346 · Clarkston, MI
findings: ZIP 48346 (Clarkston) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48346 (Clarkston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48346 (Clarkston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 9 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
